date_evidence.description: Late Mr Dixon plus 1849 death recorded in 1355 apparatus excludes older open XML years. Upper limit follows same plate request in 1322. Preserve original XML and infer no exact day.

sequence: Auckland/Herschel commission received in morning before body.
Owen refusal note just received by P5 postscript; not automatically available before P1.

evidence.quote: there arrived this morning a request from Ld. Auckland, & Sir J. Herschel
I have just received your note with sincere grief

receipt_events.description: Almost four months lying in London does not mean Darwin knew the contents throughout that delay; 1063 identifies August 30 source date without preserved text.

evidence.quote: His letter has been unfortunately lying for nearly four months in London
Your letter of August 30, with the papers which you were so good as to send me, reached me only a short time since

reference_observations.description: Missing note received; carrier failed and specimens still await pickup at uncertain location. Do not equate thanks with physical specimen receipt.

evidence.quote: the stupid Carrier forgot to call on Thursday
He will come on Monday to the College

reference_observations.description: Limbs in progress, Parthenogenesis already read. March 23 log entry does not override this sequence.

evidence.quote: I am in the middle of the “Limbs”
I read also with great interest some little time ago your kind present of Parthenogenesis

reference_observations.description: Same-author covering/formal notes sent together; no conversation edge.

evidence.quote: I write formal note to show if required
Could you oblige me by laying this request before the governing Body?

reference_observations.description: Spanish paper and translation sent, but neither text is reproduced here. Museum manuscript survival reported in 1063 footnote does not make content available in this collection.

unlocated_references.description: Muñiz August 30 letter and paper parcel; Owen Acasta suggestion.
Crossing Owen reply, Morris communication, Muñiz Spanish paper and English translation.
Opening fragment and Owen communication about Whewell scolding.
Owen Christmas note and recollection of tooth; earlier Wood request uncertain.
Morning Auckland/Herschel commission, later Owen refusal note and previously sent coral manuscript.
Microscope enclosure, separate lost geology manuscript, Owen synopsis and any request for notes.
Owen note accompanying specimen arrangement and Sulivan-support news.
Owen Ehrenberg parcel communication and unspecified contents.
Recent Sulivan expedition request, Owen introduction to Mrs Dixon and lecture prospectus.

corrections.description: Canonical first-pass description wrongly assigns Coral volume to Owen. It is Darwin book praised by Owen.
Opening I had not heard is presumed Owen insertion; do not restore it as Darwin original words.
Raw MathML half-hour and half-past times, not integer 12.
Raw MathML four-fifths time lost; planned collection and ordered book are not receipt or reading.
P3–6 address layout has stray diag/ramme markers; keep rendering hold without treating them as original prose.
